disclaimer: Recorded RoboDojo simulations with offline X-Planner predictions. The model receives sampled camera observations and the task instruction. Its own initial plan and prior predictions are supplied as memory. Its raw outputs, including mistakes, are preserved. Robot motion comes from the recording; these clips do not measure closed-loop control or task success.

demos.name: Spell RoboDojo
demos.task: Arrange the letters to spell "RoboDojo" in a row.
plan: Left arm moves above the blue letter R, grabs the letter and places it at the target position on the desktop
Left arm grasps the leftmost letter O and places it to the right of the letter R
The left arm grasps the orange letter B, places it to the right of the letter O above the desktop, then grasps the letter O on the left below the desktop and moves upward.
Left arm places the letter O it holds to the right of the letter B
The right arm moves forward
Right arm grips the letter D
Right arm places the held letter D to the right of the letter O above the desktop
Right arm grips the letter O on the left below the tabletop
Right arm places the held letter O to the right of letter D
The right arm grasps the purple letter J, places it at the position to the right of the pink letter O on the upper right side of the desktop
Right arm releases the letter J and moves downward
Right arm grabs the letter O under the table, places it to the right of the letter J
demos.review_note: Observed limitation: the final prediction at 26.28 s says Continue at 99% progress. The original output is retained.

demos.name: Build Tower
demos.task: Build a tower using the wooden blocks and wooden boards.
plan: Left arm moves to the side of the white block on the left of the desktop, grasps the block and places it on the desktop
Right arm moves to the side of the white block on the left part of the right desktop, grasps the block and places it on the desktop
Dual arms move to the two sides of the upper light yellow long wooden board, grab the board and place it on the two white support blocks.
Left arm grabs the small white square on the left side of the desktop, and places it on the upper light yellow long wooden board
Right arm grasps the white cube on the left side of the right tabletop, places it on the right end of the upper light yellow long board
Dual arms move to both sides of the lower light yellow long plank, grasp the plank and place it on the light yellow bracket with white blocks.
Left arm grabs the brown square on the left side of the desktop
Left arm moves the left brown block onto the built light yellow long board, adjusts its position, then moves next to the green block
Left arm retracts, right arm grabs the green cube and places it on the built cube
The right arm retracts from above the green cube to the right side of the frame
